cve_attempts.description: Remote code execution via PHPUnit's eval-stdin.php when left deployed in web-accessible vendor directories. Often probed alongside CVE-2024-4577 spray (Hello PHPUnit fingerprint).

Critical argument injection in PHP running as CGI on Windows. Attackers smuggle -d directives (allow_url_include, auto_prepend_file=php://input) via soft-hyphen (%AD) encoding that bypasses CVE-2012-1823 mitigations. Unauthenticated RCE when php-cgi.exe is exposed. Actively exploited by RedTail cryptominer (libredtail-http).
Unauthenticated command injection against NetScaler ADC and Gateway. citrixpot stores command text from the request and files posted to the custom LogonPoint path. It does not run the command.
FortiGate SSL-VPN issue added to CISA KEV in July 2026. Detection is an extra slash in the /lang/ path on fortipot. The older /remote/fgt_lang probe stays CVE-2018-13379.

High-severity authentication bypass in Ivanti Connect Secure, disclosed October 2026 and listed in CISA KEV. A public login request carries an X-DSCGI-PATH header naming another CGI or a runtime temp file. ivantipot stores that header and any uploaded file. It does not run the file. Rapid7 published the advisory on 13 October 2026.
FortiOS SSL VPN path traversal via /remote/fgt_lang (lang=…/dev/cmdb/sslvpn_websession)
Authentication bypass in F5 BIG-IP iControl REST allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via /mgmt/tm/util/bash.
High-severity NetScaler SAML IDP issue from bulletin CTX696300, March 2026. Detection is a /saml request on citrixpot.

Remote code execution in the F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) via authenticated path traversal (..;/). Unauthenticated attackers can create administrative accounts or execute arbitrary system commands. Widely scanned on internet-facing BIG-IP appliances.

Critical authentication bypass in cPanel & WHM (and WP Squared) allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to obtain root-level administrative access via session poisoning in the login flow (CWE-306). Internet scanners probe /___proxy_subdomain_whm/login/?login_only=1 and related WHM management ports. Patch to fixed cPanel builds immediately.

Memory overflow in NetScaler ADC and Gateway when SAML authentication is configured, leading to a denial of service. citrixpot records POST requests to SAML paths and does not interpret the SAML message.

DTLS memory issue on NetScaler ADC and Gateway that can lead to code execution or a crash. citrixpot records DTLS records and files posted under /vpn/scripts/linux/. It does not complete a DTLS handshake.
